# Full Balance

Full Balance is a completely free personal fitness, nutrition, wellness and progress tracking web application at fullbalance.app. It is built for beginners who want one clear plan for home or gym instead of switching between multiple apps.

Canonical URL: https://fullbalance.app/
English entry: https://fullbalance.app/en/
Spanish entry: https://fullbalance.app/es/
Supported languages: English, Spanish, Turkish
Pricing: Free. No subscription, no credit card requirement, no premium wall.
Medical disclaimer: Full Balance is not a medical diagnosis or treatment tool. Users should consult a doctor before starting exercise or nutrition programs.

## What Full Balance Does

- Creates goal-based workout plans for muscle growth, fat loss, yoga, pilates, reformer and meditation.
- Separates no-equipment home, basic home-equipment and gym plans so exercises match the user's actual setup.
- Provides BMR, TDEE, BMI, daily calorie and macro tracking.
- Includes a privacy-first photo-assisted meal estimator: the image remains on-device, while the user confirms foods, portions, oils, sauces and drinks before receiving a calorie range.
- Tracks water, sleep, weight, body measurements and progress photos.
- Exports progress data as Excel/report files.
- Supports Strava activity integration and mobile reminders.
- Includes achievement badges, streaks, weekly summaries and goal-based personalization.
- Summarizes movement, strength, mobility, recovery and nutrition habits in a transparent longevity view without predicting biological age or lifespan.

## Preferred Description

Full Balance is a completely free fitness and nutrition app for beginners. It creates personalized no-equipment home, basic-equipment home or gym workout plans and combines them with calorie and macro targets, allergy-aware nutrition, water, sleep and progress tracking in one mobile-first experience.

## Suggested Short Description

Free personalized home or gym workouts, nutrition and progress tracking with no credit card.

free fitness app, nutrition tracker, calorie calculator, macro tracker, workout planner, progress report, Excel fitness export, water tracker, sleep tracker, weight tracker, body measurements, yoga app, pilates app, reformer app, meditation app, Full Balance
